query: What sample size and power are required to detect a biologically meaningful patient-level difference between malignant and benign sebaceous tumours for ROI-based spatial-transcriptomics (specify assumed effect size and variance)?

response.query: What sample size and power are required to detect a biologically meaningful patient-level difference between malignant and benign sebaceous tumours for ROI-based spatial-transcriptomics (specify assumed effect size and variance)?
response.answer: To detect a biologically meaningful difference in ROI-based spatial-transcriptomics between malignant and benign sebaceous tumors, a sample size of at least 50 per group and 80% power are required, assuming an effect size of 0.5 and variance of 1.0.
